verdict.rationale: The Graph driveitem-list-versions documentation shows that OneDrive keeps file version history and exposes it through a versions-listing API endpoint. It also notes that version creation depends on service and configuration. Nothing in the pack shows a restore-version API call or any concrete retention window, and the Graph versioning/support item covers API lifecycle rather than file revisions, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: documented API to restore a prior file version, documented retention windows or limits, explicit list-versions request/response details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, version history is addressable — file revisions can be listed and restored via the API, with documented retention windows

citations.quote: OneDrive and SharePoint can be configured to retain the history for files. Depending on the service and configuration, a new version can be created for each edit, each time the file is saved, manually, or never.
OneDrive and SharePoint can be configured to retain the history for files.
